# Mike Demopoulos — CV Adventure

> The resume of Mike "Demo" Demopoulos (they/them), partnerships and technology leader, as a playable retro text adventure. Green-phosphor terminal. Type commands. Collect artifacts. Get hired.

## What this is

mikedemo.work is a single-page interactive CV game: Demo's career rendered as eight explorable rooms. Each room is a career stop with a short narrative, examinable objects, exits to other rooms, and a collectible artifact. There is no account, no login, and no backend — everything runs in the browser.

- Play: https://mikedemo.work/
- PDF CV: https://mikedemo.work/Mike_Demopoulos_CV.pdf
- Sitemap: https://mikedemo.work/sitemap.xml
- Contact (in-game CONTACT command): hey.demo@mikedemo.email · 612.807.3601 · in/mikedemopoulos · mikedemo.com

## How to play

Type commands into the prompt (or tap the shortcut keys under the screen). Type `HELP` at any time for the in-game command list.

### Command reference

- `LOOK` (alias `L`) — re-read the description of the current room.
- `GO <direction>` (aliases `MOVE`, `WALK`) — travel through an exit. Directions: `N`/`S`/`E`/`W`/`UP`/`DOWN`.
- `<direction>` — bare direction also works, e.g. `NORTH` or `N`.
- `EXAMINE <thing>` (aliases `X`, `INSPECT`) — inspect an object in the room, e.g. `EXAMINE PLAQUE`.
- `TAKE <thing>` (aliases `GET`, `GRAB`) — pick up the room's artifact, e.g. `TAKE BUSINESS`. First word of the artifact name is enough.
- `INVENTORY` (aliases `INV`, `I`) — list collected artifacts.
- `MAP` — toggle the sector map panel and list charted sectors.
- `CONTACT` (alias `HIRE`) — display Demo's real contact channels.
- `RESUME` (alias `CV`) — dump the full career text for every room.
- `CLEAR` (alias `CLS`) — wipe the screen.
- `HELP` (alias `?`) — print the command list.

## The rooms

Start in **THE ATRIUM** (lobby). Eight rooms, eight artifacts:

1. **THE ATRIUM** — the lobby; professional summary plaque and amber CRT. Artifact: `BUSINESS CARD`. Exits: north, east, south, west, up.
2. **THE CLOUD DECK — hosting.com** — Partnerships Lead, North America (Apr 2025–present); 500+ VIP/enterprise accounts, event-driven partner outreach. Artifact: `AGENCY LEDGER`. Examinable: `rack`.
3. **THE PARTNER GUILD — Codeable** — Head of Partnerships (Jun 2021–Dec 2024); cPanel/Plesk partner initiative, WP Toolkit integrations. Artifact: `TUNE KEY`. Examinable: `banners`.
4. **THE TREASURY — Open Source Matters (Joomla)** — board service and fundraising, Jan 2013–Dec 2018; $1M+ raised. Artifact: `TREASURER SEAL`. Examinable: `ledgers`.
5. **THE EVANGELIST'S FORGE — InMotion Hosting / BoldGrid** — Business Development Specialist / Product Evangelist (Oct 2016–Jun 2021); event-led GTM, 85+ meetings per CloudFest. Artifact: `EVANGELIST MIC`. Examinable: `mic`, `badges`.
6. **THE WORKSHOP — Projects & Community** — Applied AI workflows / agent tooling (MikeDemo.dev), Bugle Crowns AWS Agentic Football Cup, Out in Tech volunteerism, CloudFest Hackathon, Global Pride Parties at WordCamps. Artifact: `LEGACY CODEBASE`. Examinable: `terminal`.
7. **THE ACADEMY — Education & Certifications** — The Art Institutes Minnesota (2005); MIT Professional Education No Code AI & ML (top 1% of cohort), Out in Tech Leadership Institute, CMX Community MBA, Disney Institute, FranklinCovey. Artifact: `MIT CREDENTIAL`. Examinable: `diploma`.
8. **THE COUNCIL CHAMBER — Forbes Agency Council** — Council Member; Lead of the Web Hosting & Infrastructure Group (Jan 2026–present); two bylined Forbes articles. Artifact: `FORBES PEN`. Examinable: `press`.

## Win condition

Collect all 8 artifacts, one per room: `TAKE` each room's artifact (the game hints the first word, e.g. `TAKE BUSINESS`). When all 8 are in inventory the game prints `*** ALL ARTIFACTS RECOVERED ***` and the closing line: "Hire the player" — at which point you can type `CONTACT` to reach Demo.
